_doc: Surface textures (docs/TEXTURES.md). texgen.py: one Higgsfield image per recipe (cached), made tileable, albedo + normal/roughness/height derived. 'tile_m' = metres one tile covers in the game (informative; the shader scales live in src/render/surface_tex.c). 'period' marks structured patterns (rows / courses): their seam fix keeps the period.
style: Seamless tileable texture, straight top-down orthographic photograph, flat even overcast daylight, no shadows, no perspective, no horizon, no objects, the surface fills the whole frame edge to edge, uniform density, sharp photographic detail, physically based albedo
